organization: American Heart Association / American College of Cardiology
recommendations: Initiate lifestyle changes: heart-healthy Mediterranean or DASH diet, weight loss
Engage in at least 150 min/week moderate-intensity physical activity
Start moderate-to-high intensity statin therapy to target LDL-C reduction >= 50%
Initiate pharmacological treatment for hypertension targeting < 130/80 mmHg
Consider low-dose aspirin (75-100 mg/day) if high ASCVD risk and low bleeding risk

follow_up.action: Initiate medical therapy and dietary changes
Recheck lipid panel and blood pressure to assess efficacy and compliance
Follow up for weight reduction progression and lifestyle assessment
Repeat lipid panel, HbA1c, liver function tests (if on high-dose statin)

emergency_signs: Angina: chest pain, pressure, tightness, or squeezing radiating to arm, neck, or back
Heart attack symptoms: shortness of breath, cold sweat, dizziness
references: 2025 AHA/ACC Guideline on the Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease
